newsitem.title: USA: Loewen says still assessing Service bid.
newsitem.headline: Loewen says still assessing Service bid.

text.p: The board of Loewen Group Inc. was still discussing an unsolicited bid from Service Corp. International on Tuesday evening, a Loewen spokesman said.
"The board met from 2 (p.m.) until 7 ... and they're going back again," said Loewen spokesman Dan Peoples.
The board was meeting in Cincinnati, where the company has corporate offices.

Service Corp. last week made an unsolicited offer to buy Loewen in a stock transaction valued at $2.8 billion. The offer also calls for the assumption of $1.3 billion of Loewen debt. The proposed union would combine the nation's two largest operators of funeral homes and cemeteries.
